summary: Global Mofy AI filed a 6-K disclosing an October 19, 2026 Share Exchange and Investment Agreement to acquire an additional 4.875% of PRC-based Qifei (Shanghai) Technology from James Yang Mofy Limited, paying 3,000,000 Class B shares at $1.30 per share (aggregate $3.9 million, cash-equivalent). Combined with an August 2026 5.06% purchase, the subsidiary reaches 9.935% ownership. The transaction is a related-party deal: Chairman/CEO Haogang Yang controls seller, designee and target; the Board deemed terms no less favorable than arm's-length. Class B shares carry 20 votes, lifting Yang to ~87.9% voting power. Closing conditions include PRC filings, diligence and consents. Watch dilution, related-party governance and closing approvals.
